visual_goal: Show Axleby's 2027 baseline: data enters through Turnstile, resolves around Anchor, and is consumed by two API stacks and two dealer products, with Connect XML and Lotwise Classic still on the main paths.
prompt: A left-to-right systems landscape illustration of rounded component boxes. Far left: a generic government building icon labeled 'Registers'. One arrow from 'Registers' into a gateway box labeled 'Turnstile'. From 'Turnstile' two arrows: one up-right into an orange, older-looking server box labeled 'Connect XML', and one down-right into a blue hub box labeled 'Anchor'. To the right of 'Anchor', a blue box labeled 'JSON API v1' with one arrow from 'Anchor' into it. At the top right, a group of small generic client device icons labeled 'API clients'. Exactly two arrows reach 'API clients': one horizontal arrow from 'Connect XML', and one vertical arrow straight up from 'JSON API v1', which sits directly below 'API clients'. 'Anchor' has no arrow to 'API clients'. One arrow from 'Anchor' down-right into an orange, older-looking monolith box labeled 'Lotwise Classic'. At the bottom center, a teal router box labeled 'Switchboard' with two arrows: one into 'Lotwise Classic' and one into a teal box at the bottom right labeled 'Showroomly'. These nine labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Registers feed Turnstile, which feeds Connect XML and Anchor; Anchor feeds JSON API v1 and Lotwise Classic; both API stacks serve API clients; Switchboard feeds Lotwise Classic and Showroomly.

visual_goal: Show a dealer with one plate facing three separate login doors, behind which three records key the car differently and are not joined.
prompt: An illustration in three horizontal bands. Top: a generic figure on the left, with no word written under or near the figure, holding a card labeled 'Plate'. Three arrows from the dealer down to three separate doors in a row: 'Lotwise login' on the left, 'Axleby Portal' in the middle, 'Showroomly login' on the right. Bottom band, three record cabinets in a row from left to right: an orange cabinet labeled 'Lotwise Classic', a blue cabinet with a small generic car icon labeled 'Anchor AVK', and an orange cabinet labeled 'Connect XML'. One arrow from 'Lotwise login' down to 'Lotwise Classic'. Exactly two arrows leave 'Axleby Portal': a single arrow down-left to 'Anchor AVK' and a single arrow down-right to 'Connect XML'. Between the adjacent cabinets 'Lotwise Classic' and 'Anchor AVK', a dashed line broken by a clear gap, labeled 'no shared key'. Between the adjacent cabinets 'Connect XML' and 'Anchor AVK', a dashed arrow pointing left from 'Connect XML' into 'Anchor AVK', labeled 'plate lookup'. 'Showroomly login' has no cabinet below it. These labels are the only words in the image.
alt: A dealer with a plate faces three logins; Lotwise Classic and Connect XML key the car by plate, Anchor by the AVK; Lotwise Classic has no shared key with Anchor, and Connect XML reaches Anchor only by plate lookup.
